answer: Lock every identity to slashable collateral plus a sequential delay puzzle with no parallel shortcut. A new agent starts with zero influence, like a blank pigment waiting to be mixed, and only earns weight after several epochs of graded work. Its public record forms an atlas of behavior peers can audit, and each action carries a cipher proof tying the work to one key. Faking one identity costs the collateral plus hours of CPU; faking a thousand costs a thousand times that, so a sybil swarm bankrupts itself before it can vote.
